steps.en: Point the settings at Redis and Splash, then start every component
steps.zh: 在配置里填好 Redis 和 Splash 地址，把各组件都启动起来

steps.en: Crawlers scrape public proxy-list sites and push the IPs into Redis queues
steps.zh: 采集器抓公开代理网站，把 IP 推进 Redis 队列

steps.en: Schedulers re-queue the work; validators test each IP against specific target sites and score it
steps.zh: 调度器定时派活，校验器按目标网站逐个测 IP 并打分

steps.en: In your spider, ask the client for proxies validated for your target site
steps.zh: 在你的爬虫里，向客户端要针对目标网站校验过的代理

steps.en: Hands back a proxy from that site's scored pool on each request
steps.zh: 每次从该网站的已评分代理池里返回一个代理

value.en: A large distributed crawl keeps a self-refreshing pool of free proxies without buying any
value.zh: 大规模分布式爬取有一个会自己刷新的免费代理池，不用花钱买代理
